n053f22b165.headline: Naira bounces back after days of being battered at the official market
n053f22b165.summary: The Nigerian naira strengthened on Monday following a period of weak exchange rates against the US dollar in the official market.
n053f22b165.why: The naira is Nigeria's official currency and its exchange rate affects inflation, import costs, and investor confidence in Africa's largest economy.
